about_the_game:
In “Anura” you are Don Rano, a frog that has to cross the jungle jumping between different platforms, dodging obstacles and using the bubbles to propel himself as far as possible. Thanks to his bubbles bottle, you will be able to create bubbles that will help you reach places you didn't think you would be able to get to.

Use the bubbles to jump

Even if some platforms seem far away, you can use the bubbles on the stage to jump on them and propel yourself further. But be careful! The bubbles are fragile, and will break as soon as you touch them.

Create your own bubbles

Sometimes it may seem impossible to get to the other side, but don't worry, because Don Rano always carries his bubbles bottle on his back, so blow up and create the bubbles you need to reach the end!

Explore all levels and set your new high score!

It doesn't only matter how fast you get to the end, it also matters how fast you do it! Explore all the levels and try to beat yourself with each new attempt. Will you be the fastest frog in the whole swamp?

How far will you be able to take advantage of Don Rano's powers? Will you be able to reach the end of his adventure and find out why he had to cross the swamp? And most importantly, will you be the fastest to do it?

short_description: Join Don Rano in his adventure! A platformer in which you will have to use the bubbles of the stage, or the ones you create, to reach the most difficult platform. Will you try to go as fast as possible? Or will you take it as a calm adventure? You decide!
